name: Dimention Dev
postCreateCommand: if [ -d /root/.ssh-host ]; then mkdir -p /root/.ssh/sockets && cp -rn /root/.ssh-host/* /root/.ssh/ 2>/dev/null || true && chmod 700 /root/.ssh /root/.ssh/sockets && chmod 600 /root/.ssh/* 2>/dev/null || true && chown -R root:root /root/.ssh; fi && git config --global --add safe.directory '*' && if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . .env; set +a; fi && SCRIPT=${INSTALL_SCRIPT:-infinyti-install.sh} && if [ -f "scripts/$SCRIPT" ]; then chmod +x "scripts/$SCRIPT" && "./scripts/$SCRIPT"; else echo "Script scripts/$SCRIPT no encontrado."; fi
